runtime_instructions:
The Electron desktop app does not have a system tray icon for quick access to common actions when the main window is minimized.

### Implementation

- Add a system tray icon in `t3code/apps/desktop/src/electron/` using Electron's Tray API
- Context menu items: Show/Hide Window, New Chat, Open Recent Project (submenu with last 5), Quit
- On macOS, clicking the tray icon should toggle window visibility
- On Windows/Linux, left click shows window, right click shows context menu
- Update tray tooltip to show current connection status and active project name
- Tray icon changes to indicate backend status: green dot for connected, yellow for reconnecting, red for disconnected

### Acceptance Criteria

- Tray icon appears in system tray on all platforms
- Context menu shows all specified items
- Show/Hide toggles main window visibility
- Recent projects submenu lists last 5 opened projects
- Platform-specific click behavior works correctly
- Tooltip updates with connection status and project name
- Tray icon changes color based on backend status
- Quitting from tray properly cleans up all resources
